rca of the issue: Root cause: The model 'models/gemini-2.5-pro' was deprecated/removed on Google's side, causing litellm.NotFoundError 404 when LiteLLM called the Gemini API. Main agent updated three files (invoices.py:64, expenses.py:117, stock_invoice_import.py:101) to 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview'. Verification: All three OCR endpoints now return 200 with extracted data; backend logs confirm 'LiteLLM completion() model= gemini/gemini-3.1-pro-preview' succeeds with no NotFoundError. Fix is confirmed working.
